Confidentiality Notice: To adhere to non-disclosure agreements, proprietary production data and proprietary brand assets have been replaced with architectural schematics, structural wireframes, and generalized workflows.

{/* ===================================================== 1. PROJECT OVERVIEW & CONTEXT ====================================================== */}
CASE STUDY 01 · ENTERPRISE SAAS / B2B PRODUCT DESIGN
PROFESSIONAL WORK · ADVITIIX TECHNOVATE

Volvo Partner Connect 2.0

Designing a connected enterprise decision portal that unifies dealer performance plans, capital investments, technical competence, and compliance audits across nationwide commercial vehicle networks.

{/* Metadata Grid */}
Role Lead UX/UI & Product Designer
Company Advitiix Technovate
Domain Automotive B2B SaaS
Platform Enterprise Web Application
{/* Hero Architectural Wireframe */}
FIG 1.0 · ARCHITECTURAL SYSTEM WIREFRAME Synthesizing multi-tenant dealer operations into real-time metrics
{/* ===================================================== 2. PROBLEM STATEMENT ====================================================== */}
{getSectionTag("02 · PROBLEM DEFINITION")}

The friction of fragmented enterprise dealer operations

Prior to Partner Connect 2.0, national commercial vehicle operations suffered from extreme data fragmentation. Over 1,400+ authorized dealerships and service centers operated with isolated spreadsheets for quarterly targets, third-party certification databases, and static monthly PDF slide decks.

Regional Business Managers spent up to 6 hours before every monthly dealer meeting simply cross-referencing numbers between finance, parts supply, and service bays.

Zero Cross-Module Correlation

A decline in first-time vehicle fix rate could not be automatically connected to a lack of certified EV technicians in the service department.

Static Accountability Gaps

Audit findings from physical facility inspections sat buried in email threads without SLA tracking or ownership assignment.

{/* ===================================================== 3. TARGET USERS & PERMISSION TIERS ====================================================== */}
{getSectionTag("03 · USER RESEARCH & PERMISSION TIERS")}

Designed for Multi-Tiered Enterprise Roles

ROLE TIER 01

Regional Operations Director

Needs macro-level territory performance comparisons, zone ranking scorecards, and instant identification of non-compliant dealer clusters.

ROLE TIER 02

Dealer General Manager

Needs immediate granular visibility into their branch: open action tickets, upcoming capital investment milestones, and staff training gaps.

ROLE TIER 03

Field Consultant & Auditor

Conducts on-site showroom and workshop inspections, needing rapid checklist inputs with offline-first synchronization capabilities.

{/* ===================================================== 4. THE 8 CORE ENTERPRISE MODULES ====================================================== */}
{getSectionTag("04 · ENTERPRISE MODULE ARCHITECTURE")}

Eight interconnected operational modules

{modules.map((m) => (

{/* ===================================================== 5 & 6. DESIGN DECISIONS & INTERACTION PATTERNS ====================================================== */}
{getSectionTag("05 & 06 · UX DECISIONS & DESIGN PATTERNS")}

Balancing dense enterprise data with cognitive clarity

1. Progressive Disclosure

Rather than overloading screens with 40+ raw data columns, cards present high-level compliance indices with side-drawer expansion for audit sub-criteria.

2. Semantic Status Tokens

Established a strict token palette where amber is reserved exclusively for impending SLA breaches (within 14 days) and red triggers mandatory remediation blocks.

3. Unified Action Drawer

Every metric in the portal can be converted into an assigned corrective action ticket in two clicks, eliminating the disconnect between analytics and accountability.

{/* ===================================================== 7 & 8. ENTERPRISE COMPLEXITY & DESIGN SYSTEM ====================================================== */}
{getSectionTag("07 & 08 · DESIGN SYSTEM & TECHNICAL ARCHITECTURE")}

Component System & Frontend Feasibility

Design Tokens to React Component Alignment

Engineered atomic design components (StatusBadges, TrajectoryCharts, HeatmapCells, PermissionGuards) that map 1:1 between Figma variables and Tailwind CSS utility classes.

Zero Virtual DOM Overhead on Large Datasets

Specified windowed virtualized lists for national dealer tables exceeding 1,400+ nodes, maintaining silky 60fps scrolling performance even on rugged dealership tablets.
